Daddy was feeling off. It was so obvious, and his eyes were full of a deep sadness. She was taking aback, not sure what to do. She followed the little voice in her who urged her to come to him right away and speak to him.



- "Daddy are you ok ?" She said preoccupied. She came close to him on the couch and touch his leg to connect with him.
- "Yeah i am alright Baby girl."
- "No you are not. It was a rhetorical question. What is happening ? Since this morning you feel off ..." her tone was a mix of caring and dominance. She wanted him to speak, to light up the weight he had on his chest and she thought it was the best way to do it.



- "Was it that obvious ?"
- "To me, definitely."
- "You may be right. But i am not sure how to deal with it." Eric's voice was so low, so damn painful to hear from a man who looked strong and confident. It was like his armor fall off and at this instant she could see the man behind the mask. He was sad, tortured, almost depressed.
Emilie went closer to him, hugging Bobby's father while she could feel his tears on her shoulder.
- "Tell me what's in your heart, Daddy. You can tell me anything. I will support you. We promised, remember ?" She said the last word with her softer voice.
Eric took a deep breath like he was going to dive underwater.
- "The first time i saw you, you remembered me of my wife. She passed away not so long ago but i missed her so much. You have the same spirit, the same energy. I can see why Bobby loves you so much. I was taken aback when he presented you to me. I even couldn't help myself and touch you where is should not. And you let me. You let me and then, maybe i am crazy to think that, but you let me touch you again. You never pushed me away. It was wrong, i know it was, but you feel like heaven on earth. You are an angel. I can't stop thinking about you. I can't stop looking at you. Oh my god i can't stop touching you and it kills me ! "



Eric finished his last sentence, almost with despair in his voice. He was now standing and walking in the room. Emilie went to him and hugged him with all her strength.
- "I am so sorry, Daddy ! I did not know it was this painful to you."
- "No, the fault is mine Baby Girl ... I am the one to blame. I am the one who is looking lustfully at my daughter-in-law. I will pack my thing and go. I will not insult you more than i already did. I feel like a pig ..."
- "Don't do that, please. I want you to stay."
- "You don't understand ... I am acting crazy when i am next to you. I want to do things to you i cannot do. You are my son fiancée, for fuck’s sake."
- "And i am a grown girl too. I can make my own decision and chose who touches me and when. I have the freedom to do so don't you think ? "
- "But ..."
- "No but. I am the one in charge here, and i use my body the way i want to." Emilie was sincere and her tone indulge no reply. She was still hugging Eric and even began to caressed his arm. Her hand wondered on his muscular back ... and finished on his strong bottom.

Arousal +2
Open mind +2
Eric's addiction to Emilie +1

(Open Mind >22 and Eric addiction >10)
Emilie went even closer.
- "What are you ..."
- "Shhh ... I am just telling you that i am sorry you are feeling like that. I can feel you are tense. Lost ? I am also telling you that you can touch me, Daddy. I like the way your hands grope me. I loved the warmth of your palm."
- "But Bobby ?"
- "When he is not here, why would he care ? While he is not in the room, you can touch me wherever and whenever you want ..." Her voice was soft, warm, and full of lust.



She could feel him growing harder and harder the ore she was talking to his ear, almost kissing his lobe. Maybe it was time to show him what she meant by that ...
